name: asafarim-appsafe-workspace
description: A publicly visible, owner-gated browser encryption workspace.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe build && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-cli build && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-web build && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-api build && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-demo build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe check && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-cli check && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-cli check:test && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-web typecheck && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-api typecheck && pnpm --filter @asafarim/appsafe-demo typecheck
